verdict.rationale: Vue's docs list a first-party 'Error Reference' page alongside a 'Tooling Guide', so the project documents its error messages to some degree. The pack contains only those page titles, though, and nothing showing that dev-server or build-time errors are clear or actionable. Missing for 10: any description of dev-server/build-tool error output (overlays, code frames, suggested fixes), evidence that compiler/SFC errors point to source locations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of error-message quality.
